steps.text: Install the bottom oil ring with the gap 45 ° from the gap of the top oil ring. Recheck to be sure the ends of the expander are not overlapped. NOTE: Do not, at any time, cut off or grind the ends of the oil ring expander to prevent the ends from overlapping. Cutting off or grinding the ends of the expander will decrease the tension on the oil control rings and result in high lubricating oil comsumption.
